title: QuickBooks Online
lede: Connect BuildTrack to the QuickBooks company where your construction company keeps its books. Each company connects its own; nobody else sees it.
connection.title: Connection
notConfigured.title: The server is not set up yet
notConfigured.body: BuildTrack does not have the keys of its Intuit app yet. As soon as the BuildTrack team adds them, the button to connect your company appears here.
notConnected.title: Your QuickBooks is not connected yet
notConnected.body: When you connect, Intuit asks you to sign in and pick your company. BuildTrack never sees your password: Intuit hands it a permission that is stored encrypted, only works for your company and can be revoked at any time.
notConnected.sandboxHint: Testing environment: only an Intuit sandbox company can be connected, not the real books.
active.renewNote: The permission renews itself every day. Intuit ends it for good after 5 years; before that date it will have to be connected again.
needsReconnect.title: The connection stopped working
error.REFRESH_REJECTED: Intuit rejected the permission: it was revoked from QuickBooks, went unused for too long, or reached its 5-year limit. Connect again to continue.
error.COMPANY_INFO_FAILED: The connection exists, but the company details could not be read. Test the connection; if it keeps failing, tell the BuildTrack team.
error.ENVIRONMENT_CHANGED: The server switched environment (sandbox ↔ production) since this company was connected. Disconnect and connect again with a company of the new environment.
error.generic: There is a problem with the connection.
outcome.CANCELLED: Cancelled on Intuit's screen; nothing was connected.
outcome.AUTHORIZATION_FAILED: Intuit did not authorize the connection. Try again.
outcome.STATE_INVALID: The connection link expired or was already used. Press "Connect to QuickBooks" again.
outcome.MISSING_PARAMS: Intuit came back without the company details. Try again.
outcome.NOT_CONFIGURED: The server does not have the Intuit keys configured.
outcome.REALM_MISMATCH: A different company than the one already connected was chosen. To switch companies, disconnect the current one first.
outcome.REALM_IN_USE: That QuickBooks company is already connected to another construction company on BuildTrack, so it cannot be connected here. If it is yours and someone connected it by mistake, ask them to disconnect it first.
outcome.EXCHANGE_FAILED: Intuit did not hand over the permission. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the BuildTrack team.
outcome.SAVE_FAILED: The connection could not be saved. Try again.
scope.title: What this connection does
scope.body: It connects your company, reads its plan and its lists, links (or creates in QuickBooks) your clients, jobsites and vendors, sends client invoices and bills from the cut-over date and, when you switch it on in “Payments”, reads from QuickBooks the payments you record on them there. It does not send payments.
disconnect.title: Disconnect?
disconnect.body: BuildTrack deletes the stored permission and asks Intuit to revoke it. Nothing is deleted in your QuickBooks. To use it again you will have to connect again.
load.errorTitle: The status could not be loaded
load.errorBody: Check your internet connection and try again.
company.title: Company in QuickBooks
company.cooldown: QuickBooks was refreshed a moment ago. You can refresh again in {{seconds}} s.
company.unread: The company has not been read yet. When you refresh, BuildTrack reads its plan, which features are switched on and its lists of customers, vendors, accounts and services. That is a few reads Intuit counts; afterwards the screens work from the local copy.
company.jobs.projects: In this company each jobsite is linked to a QuickBooks Project.
company.jobs.subCustomers: In this company each jobsite is recorded as a sub-customer of its client ("Client:Jobsite"), which exists on every plan.
company.jobs.noExpenseSplit: This plan does not allow assigning expenses to a jobsite inside QuickBooks: the per-jobsite split of expenses stays in BuildTrack.
company.counts: Local copy: {{customers}} customers and jobsites · {{vendors}} vendors · {{accounts}} accounts · {{items}} products and services
mapping.title: Link to QuickBooks
mapping.desc: Which QuickBooks record corresponds to each BuildTrack client, jobsite, vendor and category.
mapping.needsRefresh: Press "Refresh from QuickBooks" first to bring in your company's lists.
mapping.hint.clients: Each BuildTrack client with its customer in QuickBooks.
mapping.hint.projects.projects: Each jobsite with its Project in QuickBooks. If missing, it can be created as a sub-customer (creating Projects from here requires a paid Intuit plan).
mapping.hint.projects.subCustomers: Each jobsite with its sub-customer in QuickBooks. If missing, it is created under the jobsite's client.
mapping.hint.vendors: The vendors from Accounts Payable. Different spellings of the same name are grouped.
mapping.hint.categories: The account each Accounts Payable category posts to.
mapping.hint.invoiceItem: The QuickBooks product or service that client invoices are recorded under.
mapping.empty.clients: There are no clients in BuildTrack.
mapping.empty.projects: There are no jobsites in BuildTrack.
mapping.empty.vendors: There are no vendors in Accounts Payable yet.
mapping.invoiceItem.label: Service for client invoices
mapping.created: "{{name}}" was created in QuickBooks and linked.
picker.none: No records with that name in the local copy. If it was added recently in QuickBooks, refresh first.
section.label: QuickBooks sections
sync.settings.title: Sending to QuickBooks
sync.settings.desc: Client invoices (with approved change orders) and bills, with their attachments. Payments are not sent.
sync.settings.prefsUnread: Your company's invoicing preferences (own numbers, discounts, sales tax) have not been read yet. Update the company from “Link” before sending.
sync.settings.cutoverHelp: Only documents dated on or after it are sent. Everything before it was already keyed into QuickBooks by hand: sending it would duplicate it.
sync.settings.autoHelp: When on, BuildTrack sends whatever is ready and corrects in QuickBooks whatever changes or is deleted here. When off, nothing leaves unless you press a button.
sync.confirm.title: Turn on automatic sending?
sync.confirm.body_one: Every minute BuildTrack will send to QuickBooks the invoices and bills that are ready and dated from {{date}}, and will update, void or delete in QuickBooks the ones that change or are deleted here.
sync.confirm.body_other: Every {{count}} minutes BuildTrack will send to QuickBooks the invoices and bills that are ready and dated from {{date}}, and will update, void or delete in QuickBooks the ones that change or are deleted here.
sync.confirm.note: Check the cut-over date: everything before it is assumed to be keyed into QuickBooks by hand already. It can be turned off at any time.
sync.list.title: Documents
sync.list.desc: From {{date}}, plus the ones already sent.
sync.list.noCutover: Choose the cut-over date to see what can be sent.
sync.remaining_one: {{count}} document is still to be sent: press “Send all ready” again.
sync.remaining_other: {{count}} documents are still to be sent: press “Send all ready” again.
sync.toast.run: Sent: {{created}} · updated: {{updated}} · voided or deleted: {{removed}} · with a problem: {{failed}}
sync.reason.PROJECT_NOT_LINKED: The jobsite is not linked to QuickBooks.
sync.reason.INVOICE_ITEM_NOT_LINKED: The QuickBooks service jobsites are billed under has not been chosen.
sync.reason.VENDOR_NOT_LINKED: The vendor is not linked to QuickBooks.
sync.reason.CATEGORY_NOT_LINKED: The category has no QuickBooks account.
sync.reason.HAS_SALES_TAX: It has sales tax: waiting for the accountant to confirm how to record it. Not sent.
sync.reason.DISCOUNT_DISABLED: It has a discount and your company has discounts turned off in QuickBooks (Settings → Sales).
sync.reason.TOTAL_BELOW_PAID: The total is now below what was already paid in BuildTrack: QuickBooks would unapply part of the payment. Check the payments or the amount before sending.
sync.reasonQbo.TOTAL_BELOW_PAID: The total is now below what was already paid in QuickBooks: sent like this, QuickBooks would unapply part of the payment. Check the amount here or the payment in QuickBooks.
sync.reason.PLAN_NO_BILLS: Your company's QuickBooks plan has no bills (Simple Start). Change the plan or mark it “do not send”.
sync.reason.DUPLICATE_DOC_NUMBER: QuickBooks already has an invoice with that number. Change the number here and it is retried on its own.
sync.reason.QBO_HAS_PAYMENTS: Deleted here, but it has payments applied in QuickBooks: it was left alone so no payment is left hanging. Check it in QuickBooks.
sync.reason.QBO_DELETED: Someone deleted it inside QuickBooks, so it is no longer updated. “Create again” sends it as a new one; if it should not be there, mark it “do not send”.
sync.reason.FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Your company's QuickBooks plan does not allow this kind of document.
sync.reason.QUICKBOOKS_UNAVAILABLE: QuickBooks did not answer. It is retried on its own.
sync.reason.RATE_LIMITED: QuickBooks asked to wait a moment (too many requests). It is retried on its own.
sync.reason.QUICKBOOKS_AUTH_REJECTED: QuickBooks refused the connection's permission. Check the connection above.
sync.reason.QBO_TEMPORARY_ERROR: QuickBooks had a temporary error. It is retried on its own.
sync.reason.STALE_OBJECT: Someone was editing it in QuickBooks at the same time. It is retried on its own.
sync.reason.QBO_REJECTED: QuickBooks rejected it. Fix the document or the link as its message says; once it changes, it is retried.
sync.reason.TOTAL_MISMATCH: QuickBooks came up with a different total than BuildTrack. Check it in QuickBooks.
sync.stopped.RATE_LIMITED: QuickBooks asked to wait (too many requests). The rest goes on the next pass.
sync.stopped.QUICKBOOKS_AUTH_REJECTED: QuickBooks refused the connection's permission. Check the connection above.
sync.stopped.QUICKBOOKS_NEEDS_RECONNECT: QuickBooks must be reconnected before sending more.
sync.stopped.QUICKBOOKS_UNAVAILABLE: QuickBooks did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.
sync.stopped.QUICKBOOKS_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server does not have the Intuit keys configured.
sync.stopped.QUICKBOOKS_REALM_CHANGED: The connected company changed while sending. Check the connection.
sync.stopped.other: Sending stopped before finishing. Try again.
sync.detail.readyAuto: Goes out on its own with the next automatic pass.
sync.detail.changed: Changed after it was sent: it will be updated in QuickBooks.
sync.detail.deleted.INVOICE: Deleted in BuildTrack: it will be voided in QuickBooks.
sync.detail.deleted.BILL: Deleted in BuildTrack: it will be deleted in QuickBooks.
sync.detail.VOIDED: Voided in QuickBooks because it was deleted in BuildTrack.
sync.detail.DELETED: Deleted from QuickBooks because it was deleted in BuildTrack.
sync.warning.ATTACHMENT_FAILED: {{sent}} of {{total}} files attached; QuickBooks did not take the rest.
payments.title: Payments from QuickBooks
payments.desc: Payments on the invoices and bills that were sent are recorded in QuickBooks and read here.
payments.on: On — every {{minutes}} min and whenever QuickBooks reports a change
payments.off: Off — payments are recorded in BuildTrack
payments.help: When on, invoices and bills sent to QuickBooks take their payments from there (checks, transfers, cards and credit memos) and are no longer recorded here. What is paid per document and per jobsite is what QuickBooks says. It only affects your company.
payments.nextCdc: Only what changed since the last one (one call)
payments.error.QUICKBOOKS_UNAVAILABLE: QuickBooks didn't answer. Try again in a few minutes.
payments.error.RATE_LIMITED: QuickBooks asked to wait (too many calls). The next read picks it up.
payments.error.QUICKBOOKS_AUTH_REJECTED: QuickBooks rejected the connection's permission. Check the connection above.
payments.error.QUICKBOOKS_NEEDS_RECONNEC: QuickBooks has to be connected again to keep reading payments.
payments.error.QUICKBOOKS_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server doesn't have the Intuit keys set up.
payments.error.QUICKBOOKS_REALM_CHANGED: The connected company changed during the read. Check the connection.
payments.error.QBO_REJECTED: QuickBooks refused the payments query. The next read tries again.
payments.error.PAYMENTS_APPLY_FAILED: Some documents could not be updated. The next read tries them again.
payments.error.other: The payments read stopped before finishing. Try again.
payments.toast.on: Done: payments are now read from QuickBooks.
payments.toast.off: Payments are recorded in BuildTrack again.
payments.local.title: Payments recorded in BuildTrack, not in QuickBooks
payments.local.body_one: {{count}} sent document has payments recorded in BuildTrack for {{amount}}. They no longer count: record them in QuickBooks and they will show up here on their own.
payments.local.body_other: {{count}} sent documents have payments recorded in BuildTrack for {{amount}}. They no longer count: record them in QuickBooks and they will show up here on their own.
payments.webhook.title: QuickBooks notices (webhooks)
payments.webhook.onHelp: QuickBooks reports when a payment is recorded, changed or deleted, and BuildTrack reads it within a minute. The read every {{minutes}} minutes picks up anything a notice misses.
payments.webhook.offHelp: Without notices, payments are read every {{minutes}} minutes and with “Refresh payments”. Notices are set up by whoever runs the BuildTrack server (once, for every company).
payments.recent.title: Last payments read
payments.recent.desc: The latest that came from QuickBooks, including payments deleted there.
payments.recent.empty: No payment has been read from QuickBooks yet.
payments.confirm.title: Read payments from QuickBooks?
payments.confirm.body: From now on, payments on the invoices and bills sent to QuickBooks are recorded in QuickBooks and show up here on their own. They can no longer be recorded in BuildTrack for those documents.
payments.confirm.note: Payments already recorded here stay in the history, flagged, and stop counting until they are recorded in QuickBooks. A full read runs now. It can be turned off at any time.
sync.localPayments_one: {{count}} sent document has payments recorded in BuildTrack that are not in QuickBooks. They no longer count: record them in QuickBooks.
sync.localPayments_other: {{count}} sent documents have payments recorded in BuildTrack that are not in QuickBooks. They no longer count: record them in QuickBooks.
sync.localPaymentsRow_one: {{count}} payment recorded in BuildTrack, not in QuickBooks:
sync.localPaymentsRow_other: {{count}} payments recorded in BuildTrack, not in QuickBooks:
